text: Every moment think steadily as a Roman and a man to do what thou hast in hand with perfect and simple dignity, and feeling of affection, and freedom, and justice, and to give thyself relief from all other thoughts.
For he who is excited by anger seems to turn away from reason with a certain pain and unconscious contraction.
Do not waste the remainder of thy life in thoughts about others, when thou dost not refer thy thoughts to some object of common utility.
In the morning when thou risest unwillingly, let this thought be present,--I am rising to the work of a human being.
